title: sdsforge document.yaml
description: The source document for one Safety Data Sheet. Generated from the osha content library; see docs/document-yaml.md for the prose reference.

hazard_codes.description: GHS hazard codes for the product as a whole. This is the main control: Section 2 is computed entirely from these, and they auto-select the wording of Sections 4, 6, 8 and 11. Run `sdsforge document classify <id>` to see what a set produces.

materials.description: The composition table for Section 3. One entry per ingredient.

precautionary_text.title: Precautionary text
precautionary_text.description: Wording for precautionary statements, keyed by P-code. Any statement the classification selects may be overridden here, but the ones that NEED an entry are those whose regulatory text is manufacturer-specified -- the ones `sdsforge document classify <id>` marks with an asterisk. Only those are offered as completions; the rest are still accepted. An override for a code the classification does not select is an error.

P220.description: Keep away from clothing and other combustible materials.

P221.description: Take any precaution to avoid mixing with combustibles.

P230.description: Keep wetted with suitable material specified by the manufacturer.

P231+P232.description: Handle and store contents under inert gas. Protect from moisture.

P241.description: Use explosion-proof electrical, ventilating and lighting equipment.

P250.description: Do not subject to grinding, shock or friction.

P260.description: Do not breathe dust, fume, gas, mist, vapours or spray.

P261.description: Avoid breathing dust, fume, gas, mist, vapours or spray.

P280.description: Wear protective gloves, protective clothing, eye protection and face protection.

P284.description: In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection.

P285.description: In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection.

P302+P352.description: IF ON SKIN: Wash with plenty of water.

P320.description: Specific treatment is urgent (see first aid instructions on this label).

P321.description: Specific treatment (see first aid instructions on this label).

P370+P378.description: In case of fire: Use appropriate media to extinguish.

P401.description: Store in accordance with local, regional, national and international regulations.

P406.description: Store in corrosive resistant container with a resistant inner liner.

P411.description: Store at temperatures not exceeding the manufacturer-specified maximum.

P413.description: Store bulk masses greater than the manufacturer-specified quantity at temperatures not exceeding the specified maximum.

P501.description: Dispose of contents and container in accordance with local, regional, national and international regulations.

examples.P260: Do not breathe mist or spray.

product_name.description: The product's name. Feeds Section 1's product identifier, and titles the rendered sheet.

prop65.description: California Proposition 65 warnings, one entry per chemical requiring disclosure under Cal. Code Regs. tit. 27 §25603. Omit it and Section 15 states that no components are known to require a warning.

right_to_know.description: State Right-to-Know disclosures. Produces one table per state that ends up with at least one chemical flagged true.

sara_hazards.description: SARA 311/312 hazard-category disclosures. A chemical with more than one hazard category gets one entry per hazard.

sections.title: Section overrides
sections.description: Per-section choices, keyed by the section's stable id -- never by number or directory name, so renumbering the library never invalidates a saved document. A section left out resolves entirely to its defaults.

block_images.title: Images block
block_images.description: A row of pictures. Artwork referenced by path is embedded as a data: URI when the sheet is generated, so the finished document stands alone.

alt.description: What a screen reader announces, and what a text-only rendering falls back to. Required: an image without it is treated as invalid.

src.description: Path to the artwork, or a data: URI.

defaultSnippets.label: images
defaultSnippets.description: One image with the alt text it requires.

block_prose.title: Prose block
block_prose.description: Paragraphs of text, one per list entry.

block_table.title: Table block
block_table.description: A single table. Every cell is a string.

rows.description: Rows, each a list of string cells. Nothing is parsed as a number: "1000 ppm" and "N/E" are ordinary cell values.

defaultSnippets.label: table
defaultSnippets.description: A table with one header row and one data row to fill in.

block_tables.title: Named tables block
block_tables.description: Several independently-headed tables, e.g. one per state.

rows.description: Rows, each a list of string cells. Nothing is parsed as a number: "1000 ppm" and "N/E" are ordinary cell values.

defaultSnippets.label: tables
defaultSnippets.description: One named table to fill in.

hazard_code.description: A GHS hazard code. Written as H315, h315, or a bare 315 -- YAML parses the last as an integer, and all three are accepted.

identification.title: Identification
identification.description: Feeds Section 1's product identifier and recommended-use subsections. Section 1 expects both recommended_use and restrictions filled in.

cas_number.description: CAS registry number for the product itself, where it has one.

recommended_use.description: What the product is for, e.g. "Industrial cleaning agent".

restrictions.description: Restrictions on use, e.g. "Not for consumer use".

synonyms.description: Other names the product goes by.

material.title: Material
material.description: One row of Section 3's ingredient table.

cas_number.description: CAS registry number. Quote it -- a leading-zero CAS number needs quoting to survive YAML.

hazard_codes.description: GHS codes for this material specifically. Unioned into the document's overall hazard set.

hazards_triggered.description: Deprecated and unread. Use hazard_codes instead.

percentage.description: Concentration as free text, e.g. "50" or "10-30".

sequence.description: Deprecated and unread. Kept so documents written before hazard_codes existed still load.

prop65_warning.title: Proposition 65 warning
prop65_warning.description: One chemical requiring a California Prop 65 disclosure.

chemical.description: The chemical's name, as it should appear in the warning sentence.

exposure.description: Which hazard the chemical is listed for. An unrecognized value is silently dropped rather than failing the document, so a typo here costs you the whole warning.

right_to_know_entry.title: Right-to-Know entry
right_to_know_entry.description: One chemical's state Right-to-Know disclosure. State flags are plain sibling keys of chemical/cas_number, not a nested map: write a lowercase two-letter postal code set to true or false directly alongside them.
